coverIntro: Verkerk distributes produce in returnable crates. Paper slips and manual entry leave the balance per customer unreliable, so disputed crates are often written off. How can Verkerk intervene before balances become losses? Datavance turns the unchanged driver workflow and AFAS customer data into a current crate register. The register links deliveries and returns to the right customer while retaining the drivers' familiar paper slips. Nienke and Sven can review outstanding crates after Friday's input, and Kees can bring customer exports to the quarterly balance discussions.
situation: Nienke and Sven spend five hours weekly entering slips, while customer balances still do not reconcile. Drivers record deliveries and returns on paper. AFAS holds customer and invoicing data, while crate movements currently exist only in slips and Excel.
goals: See a weekly crate balance per customer
Identify rising balances before quarterly reviews
approach: Drivers keep using paper. We link the current slip input with AFAS, calculate delivered minus returned crates and show the running balance in Power BI. Drivers keep their existing paper workflow. Each entered slip provides customer, date, delivered and returned quantities; we align customer codes with AFAS and accumulate the balance from the season's start. Rising customer balances stand out in the weekly overview, and Kees receives customer exports for quarterly discussions.
scopeDeliverables: AFAS customer-data connection. Matches customer codes in the existing input to the invoicing records.
Running crate-balance calculation. Processes each slip's date, deliveries and returns into an accumulated balance per customer.
Weekly dashboard and customer export. Highlights rising balances after Friday's input and supplies standalone exports for quarterly customer meetings.

phases.name: Week 1
phases.description: Connect AFAS and validate one week of slips. Agree the slip format and customer codes, using one week of input as a validation sample.

phases.name: Weeks 2–4
phases.description: Build, test and deliver the register. Compare a weekly run with the last quarterly balance and adjust the result with Nienke and Sven.

investment: One fixed price for this scoped problem, confirmed after the scoping call. The call confirms the AFAS setup, slip format and weekly rhythm before work starts.
nextSteps: Approve the proposal, then validate one week of slips with Nienke and Sven. Check the opening balances and source format together, then confirm when week one can begin.
